items.summary: AI spend is measurable for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-26: $948.88 across 5,327 calls, including 230 errors and 5 transient errors. Contribution margin is not calculable because infrastructure, domains, labor, marketing, and other operating costs are absent, while revenue is only one day and site-attributed commission is $0. Cost-to-learn is also not calculable because experiment-level cost and incremental attributable outcomes are unavailable.

Budget exposure cannot be bounded: monthly spend limit, fixed monthly costs, marketing budget, revenue floor, and attribution materiality threshold are blank in the brief. Minimum finance measurement is a period-aligned site ledger covering attributable revenue, AI cost, infrastructure cost, domains, labor, marketing, and experiment-level incremental outcomes. Use existing evidence only; do not request duplicate telemetry or treat missing values as zero.

CFO handoff: retain the existing reconciliation, measurement, failed-run containment, and security-evidence workstreams. Update measurement records with source dates and separately label revenue, attribution, contribution margin, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, budget exposure, and causal lift as unknown where unsupported. Requeue or fund no work without documented attributable upside or cost saving.

Retain private launch gates and authorize only bounded read-only evidence work. Rights-dependent monetization and external spend remain blocked. Technical metrics such as impressions, clicks, sessions, conversions, performance scores, or AI calls are not financial returns and must not be presented as such.
